Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Encryption evidence request: rotation snapshot & HSM operator matrix

Hi Vanessa,

As part of our upcoming SOC 2 readiness window next week the auditors have asked for a compact package showing recent key rotation state and operator custody for tenant keys. Specifically they want: 

- Rotation snapshot (CSV) covering the last 12 months for tenant envelope keys and KEKs, with timestamps and actor IDs.
- HSM operator matrix (who has admin/operator access, roles, and last training/attestation date).
- A short narrative describing how at-rest encryption keys are rotated and how transit wrapping is handled when we move keys across regions.
- Any attestation or HSM vendor seal (if available) that we can include in the evidence bundle.

Can Redwood share the artifacts by EOD 25 Apr? If that timeline is tight, please let us know an ETA — auditor is flexible within that window but needs the package before the control testing begins.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Security Compliance Manager
Clearline Technologies

[external note: please send via secure SFTP or Drive link; do not include plaintext secrets in email]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 19 Apr 2029 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence request: rotation snapshot & HSM operator matrix

Adding a few details from the infra side: 

- At-rest key rotation cadence: tenant envelope keys rotate on-demand (rekey) and KEKs are scheduled quarterly; rotation events are recorded in the rotation audit index (immutable append-only ledger). I'll include a short narrative (approx 1 page) describing KEK wrapping, KMS role separation, and automated eviction of cached KEKs on rotation.
- Transit: we use TLS1.3 with mutual auth for all inter-region key transport; KEKs are never transmitted plaintext — we wrap with the destination region's wrapping key and perform an integrity check.
- HSM attestation: our vendor has a quarterly seal PDF; I'm pulling the most recent attestation and will confirm operator roster.

I've uploaded a working copy of the operator roster and a sample rotation extract to our internal drive for review: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-clearline-evidence

[attachment: operator-matrix-20290418.csv]

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Trust Engineer

Maya / Tilde team — attaching the requested evidence package for your SOC 2 control testing. Items included below and uploaded to the secure SFTP path and Drive link: sftp://secure.redwood.com/clearline/2029-04-evidence-pack and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-clearline-evidence

Attachments included:
- hsm-attestation-20290418.pdf (vendor seal / attestation)
- rotation-log-20290418.csv (rotation snapshot; columns: key_id, wrapped_by, rotation_type, prev_key_digest, new_key_digest, timestamp, actor_id, note)
- operator-matrix-20290418.csv (operator roster, role, last_attestation_date, region)
- s3-encryption-settings-20290418.txt (short config export showing KMS CMK references and default envelope policy)

Summary: 
- KEKs are rotated quarterly, and per-tenant envelope rekeys occur on-demand. Rotation events are recorded in our rotation ledger and are available in the attached CSV.
- Transit: all key transfers use mutual-TLS + wrapping; KEKs are never exported plaintext.
- HSM attestation: vendor attestation is attached (PDF). Operator access is role-scoped; privileged operator actions require dual-auth where noted in operator-matrix.

If you prefer the bundle delivered via a different mechanism (DocuSign/secure transfer), let me know and we can push to that endpoint. Please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts satisfy the auditor's initial requests or if you need a brief walkthrough.

Thanks,
